golden_set_v1_metrics._comment: rev2: CANONICAL numbers under the spec inference protocol (sliding window stride=1 + overlap-averaging + model-selected anchor, alpha=1.0). Cross-verified: GDS ran FretWise's eval_phrase_window_golden.py and reproduced these exactly. Supersedes the rev1 single-window/no-overlap/alpha=0.2 numbers (per_note 0.5088), which were a non-canonical harness artifact — NOT a model difference (anchor_accuracy matched all along).

eval_protocol.windowing: Slide a window of 5 notes (stride=1) across the phrase; non-chord notes only.
eval_protocol.anchor: Model-SELECTED per window (not GT-imposed): argmax of anchor_prob - alpha*mean(slot_NLL), alpha=1.0.
eval_protocol.decoding: Average overlapping per-note softmaxes (spec step 6) before argmax — phrase-level smoothing.
eval_protocol.chord_notes: Treated SEQUENTIALLY (onset=order). Confirmed identical on both sides — NOT a source of divergence.
eval_protocol.scoring_scope: ALL notes of each golden case (not just the first window).
eval_protocol.reference_impl: fretwise/scripts/eval_phrase_window_golden.py (LearnedPhraseWindowFingerer.predict_sequence); GDS golden harness updated to match in scripts/eval_phrase_window_v1.py.
eval_protocol.rev1_note: The deprecated rev1 GDS harness scored only the first <=5 notes of each case, no overlap-averaging, alpha=0.2.
